name: quiroads-clinic-marketing
description: Four skills for people who market health clinics: audit who owns and controls a clinic's Meta Ads assets, review ads and landing pages against platform policies and health advertising rules, set up lead follow-up over WhatsApp, SMS and calls, and turn first visits into care plans. By QuiroAds, a marketing agency for chiropractic clinics.

interface.longDescription:
Four skills for agencies, consultants, developers, clinic owners and practice managers who market health clinics, in English and Spanish.

Clinic Meta Ads ownership and access audit: walks the user through Meta Business Suite screen by screen to find out who owns and controls the clinic's ad account, Page, Instagram, dataset, WhatsApp account and domain, and which former agencies or staff still have access. It ranks the risks by severity, each with the official fix, separates what the clinic can recover from what has to be rebuilt because Meta does not transfer it, and drafts a message asking the previous agency to release the assets.

Clinic ad compliance review: checks an ad, the description of its image or video, a landing page, an organic post or a WhatsApp sales message against the Meta and Google health ad policies and the health advertising rules of Spain, the United Kingdom, the United States and Australia. For each problem it quotes the exact phrase, names the rule with its source, rates how serious it is and suggests a rewrite, then rewrites the whole piece.

Clinic lead follow-up: designs a speed-to-lead system that works with any tool, from a spreadsheet to a CRM: a first WhatsApp message within minutes, call and voicemail scripts, a short follow-up sequence, booking confirmations and reminders, consent texts, SMS where WhatsApp doesn't reach, and a sheet to measure response time, bookings, attendance and lead-to-patient rate.

Clinic patient retention and care plan conversion: scripts the first visit and the report of findings for the practitioner and the assistant, presents the care plan and the payment options, answers the usual objections, and sets up the messages for patients who do not start, missed visits, plan renewals, reactivation and reviews.

Limits: the skills are instructions only. They don't connect to Meta, Google, WhatsApp or the clinic's software, they read no web pages, and they need no patient names or data. They report the problems they find with the rules as checked on a stated date; the final decision on an ad belongs to the platform and the regulator, and laws outside the four countries are not covered.

By QuiroAds, a marketing agency that works only with chiropractic clinics: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, SEO and automation.
